We need to produce a test class for BaseJsonValidator#getParentSchema. Since BaseJsonValidator is abstract, we need a concrete subclass for testing. We can create a minimal subclass within test, maybe as an inner class extending BaseJsonValidator and implementing abstract methods (validate). Provide necessary constructor arguments: schemaPath, schemaNode, parentSchema, validatorType, validationContext, suppressSubSchemaRetrieval (optional). We'll mock dependencies: JsonSchema parentSchema (mock), JsonNode schemaNode (mock), ValidatorTypeCode validatorType (maybe mock or use a real enum if exists; but we can mock). ValidationContext can be mocked, but its constructor requires many dependencies; we can mock it as well.

Goal: test that getParentSchema returns the same parentSchema passed in constructor.

Test cases:
- When parentSchema is non-null, getParentSchema returns that mock.
- When parentSchema is null, returns null.

We need to instantiate BaseJsonValidator subclass with appropriate constructor. Use Mockito to mock JsonSchema, JsonNode, ValidatorTypeCode, ValidationContext.

Also need to import necessary classes.

Implement @BeforeEach to set up mocks and validator instance.

Write two @Test methods.

Make sure not to access private fields.

Add necessary imports: com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode; maybe others.

We'll use static import for assertions.

Now produce final code.
